passes.scan: 4 frames, same ramen-cart set: red lantern left, noren curtains top, counter, stools, stock pot on the burner right. f1 10.2 s and f2 11.2 s: Kuroe from behind-left on his stool holding the monocle up on its chain, bowl at the counter, Mio leaning on the counter; f3 12.2 s and f4 13.4 s: Kuroe turned to camera holding a monocle up by his face, Mio with a ladle over an empty bowl. Two people in every frame, nobody pops in or out; no ghosts, text or seams. In f3 and f4 there are TWO monocles: one in his hand on its chain and one still worn on his left eye
passes.map: night ramen cart: counter runs across the frame, Mio behind it, Kuroe on a stool in front; same layout in all four frames
passes.support: f1-f2: monocle in his right hand, chain down to his coat; bowl held by Kuroe (f1) and passed between their hands (f2); f3-f4: hand-held monocle chain runs down to his left lapel and pocket, a second chain hangs from a pin on his right lapel across the waistcoat to nothing visible; the worn monocle on his left eye has no chain; ladle in Mio's hand; Kuroe seated on a stool
passes.cast: Kuroe: hair grey/silver, moustache grey, suit black, waistcoat dark grey, shirt white, tie burgundy, pocket square white: matches in every frame (tie and face visible in f3-f4); the Cast's monocle is on his RIGHT eye, the worn one in f3-f4 is on his LEFT eye. Mio: orange-red ponytail, white headband, green apron, black T-shirt, orange eyes: matches in every frame
passes.beat: C4: Kuroe turns on the stool (f1-f2 back view to f3-f4 facing camera, yes); holds up the monocle (yes, every frame); Mio ladles (ladle over the bowl in f3-f4, yes); 'the monocle now in his hand': contradicted in f3-f4, where a monocle is still on his eye as well
